reason: All six revised pilot generations completed, but six of twelve judgments failed exact-quote validation after retries. Inspection found unsupported quantitative details that some judges still accepted. Stop the paid quality subtest; do not promote v8 based on it.
scope: Same 24 cases, v7/v8 prompts, provider, anonymization and shared $0.50 / 192-call cap. Generate remaining 42 outputs only; no additional judges or simulation reruns.
product_decision: Keep v7 as default. Add deterministic current decisions, observation windows and a number-review aid; v8 remains experimental.
metrics: Report generation completion, coverage of decision actors and configured actors separately, branches with unanchored Arabic quantities, generation retries, latency and returned usage. Quantity matches are a review heuristic, not proof of grounding or hallucination.
